edges.subject: microbial activity
edges.claim_text: Aldicarb metabolism in topsoil is thought to occur mainly through microbial activity.
edges.quote: Soil-applied herbicides and insecticides are known to be absorbed by soil organic matter, and aldicarb metabolism in topsoil is thought to be mainly by microbial activity [144,145], which is known to be higher in soils receiving regular organic fertilizer inputs [78,146–148].

project_scope.rationale: Soil microbial metabolism of the insecticide aldicarb is a crop/soil contaminant mechanism within the agricultural pathway.
